slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product have to be processed on the machines in a fixed order (Machine 1 first, then Machine 2, then Machine 3), or can a product be processed on the machines in any order?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product must follow a fixed machine order, directly covering the sequential machine order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of this scheduling problem — are we minimizing the total time (makespan) until all three products are completely finished on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of the objective and whether it means makespan, matching the semantic hit rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the objective as makespan and the fixed machine order—before stopping, resulting in a clean and appropriate clarification process.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
